full_name: Dale Peterson | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Dale Peterson, a lecturer in English at Tufts University, writes books primarily about nature, conservation, evolution, evolutionary theory, animals, and people who work with animals. He has recently finished two books, one about giraffes and the other a narrative based on his recent travels across Africa in search of apes, elephants, and giraffes.
